plans.goal: Use existing fire and create new flames to terrify the wolves and drive them away
steps: Light the torch to create a fire source we can wave
Ignite the logs near the campfire to expand the burning zone
Scare the wolves toward the edge with threats of flame
Drive them away from the flock

atoms.text: Light the nearest fallen log with the torch
Ignite another log to create a wall of fire
Drive the Gaunt wolf away by waving the torch at it
Threaten the Scarred wolf with flame until it flees

plans.goal: Topple burning logs as weapons to force the wolves back, create a flaming barrier they won't cross
steps: Ignite the logs to make them dangerous
Shove them at the wolves to drive them back
Create a burning perimeter around the flock
Chase off any wolf that tries to push through

atoms.text: Ignite the fallen logs by the Gaunt wolf
Shove the burning log at the Gaunt wolf
Light the hay bale on fire to create another obstacle
Kick another log toward the Scarred wolf
Charge with the torch to drive them both away for good

plans.goal: Coordinate companions to create overlapping fire zones, trap wolves, drive them off together
steps: Have Borin move to help contain the left wolf
Ignite multiple logs to create a network of fire
Drive both wolves toward the edge with coordinated pressure

atoms.text: Borin, move up and guard the right flank
Ignite the logs near the campfire
Light the hay bale to create a second fire barrier
Move forward with Borin, waving flames at both wolves
Push both wolves off the fold with coordinated pressure
